zh.title: 達美航空波音757客機因加壓問題折返紐約JFK
zh.summary: 達美航空波音757因加壓問題折返紐約JFK；該公司正逐步替換近30年機齡機隊。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，達美航空（Delta Air Lines）一架波音 757-200 型客機因機艙加壓問題，折返紐約JFK（JFK）機場。該航機在發生加壓異常狀況後進行返航處置。
這起波音 757 機型的加壓事件發生之際，達美航空正逐步替換旗下機齡接近 30 年的機隊。該公司目前正持續推進老舊機隊的替換工作。
本次加壓問題涉及達美航空的波音 757 客機，該航空公司正按計畫逐步更換其近 30 年機齡的 757 機群。

en.title: Delta Boeing 757-200 Returns To New York-JFK (JFK) Following Pressurization Issue
en.summary: Delta Air Lines Boeing 757 returned to New York JFK due to pressurization issues during flight.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying, a Delta Air Lines Boeing 757-200 returned to New York-JFK (JFK) after experiencing pressurization issues. The aircraft turned back due to the pressurization problem encountered during flight.

This latest pressurization incident involving a Boeing 757 occurs as Delta Air Lines gradually replaces its aircraft fleet. The carrier is working to replace its Boeing 757 fleet as the aircraft reach nearly 30 years of age.

The incident highlights ongoing fleet changes as Delta Air Lines replaces its nearly 30-year-old Boeing 757 aircraft. The airline continues to phase out these older models as part of its fleet replacement effort.

zh.title: 印度兩家企業簽署意向協定 擬採購85架俄製Il-114-300客機
zh.summary: 印度Pinnacle與Sleek公司簽署意向書，擬引進85架俄製支線客機。
body: 兩家印度航空企業已簽署初步協定，擬引進共85架俄羅斯製造的伊留申 Il-114-300 雙渦輪螺旋槳客機。此項非約束性協定於2026年9月10日在新德里舉辦的展覽上宣布，其中 Pinnacle Air 簽署了50架客機的意向書，而 Sleek Aviation 則針對35架客機簽署了合作備忘錄。
這些初步協議目前並非確認訂單。值得注意的是，這兩家印度企業目前均未營運航空公司。根據歷史紀錄，該型 Il-114-300 客機目前獲得的俄羅斯聯邦航空運輸署（Rosaviatsiya）型號合格證限制較多，其飛行作業僅限於攝氏零下9度至25度之間的窄幅溫度區間。

en.title: Two Indian Firms Sign Preliminary Agreements for 85 Russian Il-114-300 Turboprops
en.summary: Two Indian companies sign preliminary agreements in New Delhi for 85 Russian Il-114-300 turboprop aircraft.
body: Two Indian aviation companies have signed preliminary agreements for a total of 85 Russian-built Ilyushin Il-114-300 turboprop aircraft. The non-binding agreements were announced on September 10, 2026, during an exhibition in New Delhi. Under these deals, Pinnacle Air signed a letter of intent for 50 aircraft, while Sleek Aviation signed a memorandum of understanding for 35 aircraft.

These preliminary agreements are not firm orders. Notably, neither Pinnacle Air nor Sleek Aviation currently operates an airline. According to historical records, the Il-114-300's current type certificate issued by Russia's Rosaviatsiya restricts flight operations to a narrow weather band, limiting temperatures to between -9°C and +25°C.

zh.title: 聯合航空因民眾疑慮取消丹佛九一一紀念飛越
zh.summary: 聯合航空因民眾疑慮，取消包含波音777與F-16戰機的丹佛九一一紀念飛越。
body: 聯合航空在考量當地社區意見後，決定取消原定於美國丹佛舉行的九一一事件25週年紀念飛越活動。丹佛緊急事務管理局於2026年9月9日證實該項取消消息。原本的飛越計劃預計由一架波音777客機與四架科羅拉多州空軍國民警衛隊的F-16戰機組成編隊，在聯合航空丹佛飛行訓練中心舉辦私人員工追思會期間進行飛越。
雖然飛越活動已被喊停，但聯合航空表示其他紀念活動將照常舉行。該公司計劃在其丹佛飛行訓練中心揭幕一座由紐約世界貿易中心鋼材製成的紀念碑，高度為9英呎11英吋，以悼念聯合航空175號與93號班機的機組人員。此外，聯合航空與美國航空員工亦計劃在丹佛國際機場（DEN）舉行默哀儀式。

en.title: United Airlines cancels Denver 9/11 memorial flyover following public feedback
en.summary: United Airlines canceled a planned Denver 9/11 flyover featuring a Boeing 777 and F-16 fighters after community feedback.
body: United Airlines has canceled a planned flyover in Denver marking the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks following feedback from the local community. Denver's Office of Emergency Management confirmed the cancellation on September 9, 2026. The proposed formation was scheduled to feature a United Boeing 777 escorted by four Colorado Air National Guard F-16 fighters over the airline's Denver Flight Training Center during a private employee memorial.

Despite suspending the flyover, United Airlines confirmed that other planned remembrance events will proceed as scheduled. The carrier intends to unveil a 9-foot-11-inch monument constructed from World Trade Center steel at its training facility to honor the crews of United Flights 175 and 93. Additionally, employees from both United Airlines and American Airlines plan to observe moments of silence at Denver International Airport (DEN).

zh.title: 龐巴迪Global 8000獲准降落倫敦城市機場（LCY）
zh.summary: 英國民航局核准Global 8000降落倫敦城市機場（LCY）
body: 龐巴迪（Bombardier）於2026年9月10日宣布，英國民航局（CAA）已核准Global 8000降落倫敦城市機場（LCY），該項核准自即日起生效。
此核准僅適用於其民航主管機關已批准Global 8000陡降進場補充說明書的註冊國家。倫敦城市機場是英國唯一要求陡降進場能力的機場，進場下滑道為5.5度，遠高於一般約3度的下滑道。
龐巴迪表示，該機型的設計使其適合倫敦城市機場的短跑道操作，並指出使用該機場相較於法恩堡或盧頓，可節省旅客一小時至一個半小時的地面轉乘時間。
龐巴迪描述Global 8000為自協和號以來最快的民用飛機，最高速度達0.95馬赫，並已獲得加拿大運輸部、美國聯邦航空總署及歐盟航空安全局的認證。

en.title: Bombardier Global 8000 cleared to land at London City Airport (LCY)
en.summary: UK CAA clears Bombardier Global 8000 to land at London City Airport (LCY)
body: Bombardier announced on September 10, 2026, that the UK Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) has cleared the Global 8000 to land at London City Airport (LCY), effective immediately.

The clearance applies only to aircraft registered in jurisdictions whose aviation authority has approved the Global 8000's steep approach supplement. London City is the only UK aerodrome requiring a steep approach capability, with a 5.5-degree glideslope.

Bombardier estimates that access to London City can save passengers 60 to 90 minutes of ground transfer compared with Farnborough or Luton. The manufacturer describes the Global 8000 as the fastest civil aircraft since Concorde, with a top speed of Mach 0.95.
The type is certified by Transport Canada, the US Federal Aviation Administration and the European Union Aviation Safety Agency, with certification from other authorities ongoing, Bombardier says.
